findings.title: API success dropped to 99% during the fault
findings.evidence: 72 requests, status counts {'200': 53, '204': 18, 'timeout': 1}, p95 1238.7 ms (baseline 41.2 ms)

summary: Dropping packets on `mongodb` (network_loss) moved API success from 100% to 99% across 72 samples; 1 service affected; recovered in 18 s without intervention.
production_implication: In production a network_loss on mongodb would be absorbed with little or no user-visible impact.
